newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki spurred by Nokia, but correction in view.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki spurred by Nokia, but correction in view.

text.p: * Helsinki ends lively session higher for the fourth straight day boosted by Nokia's gains on Wall Street. But brokers saw a downward correction after the recent rally.
* Vol FIM 412 million, 51 pct in Nokia
Shares closed a lively session up for the fourth day in a row on Tuesday, and the HEX index ended at its highest since October 2, 1995 as Nokia rallied after gains on Wall Street, brokers said.
But a downward correction was in view after the recent strong gains, they said.
"I think shares will correct lower on Wednesday as we have risen quite a lot during the last few days," one broker said.
Nokia closed active trade 1.00 markka up at 197.50 after breaking 200.00 markka for the first time since end-May. One broker saw the share's resistance at about 210.00 markka.
Markka strength and recent bearish views by sector analysts sent forestries lower, brokers said.
But they said data services group TT Tieto was lifted by positive analyst comments. The share closed up 5.00 markka at 245.00 after hitting a new life-high 250.00 in fair trade.

Metals and mining group Outokumpu advanced one markka in lively trade helped by recent gains in cyclical stocks on Wall Street. Steel group Rautaruukki closed unchanged at 40.00 markka after hitting a calendar year-high 40.50 in fair trade.
Engineering group Santasalo rose 1.00 markka to 37.00 in brisk demand ahead of January-August results due on Friday.
